title: 1 dead, 3 hurt as 10-wheeler hits cargo truck in Cotabato town

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — A cargo truck driver was killed while his helper and two other people were injured when a 10-wheeler truck loaded with construction materials rammed the rear of another cargo truck shortly after midnight on Saturday, Nov. 28, in Makilala, Cotabato.
